questions.question: Which week should Saturday and Sunday belong to?

options.label: Monday start
options.adds: Weeks start on Monday, so Saturday and Sunday belong to the Monday-to-Sunday week that ends on them.

options.label: Sunday start
options.adds: Weeks start on Sunday, so Saturday belongs to the Sunday-to-Saturday week.
